description: Restaurants and bars: adds a table (or several identical ones) with its seats. Online bookings get the smallest free table that fits the party. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

from_party_of.description: Smallest party it is given to online, default 1.

name.description: e.g. "Table" or "Terrace". Numbered automatically when count > 1.

name: add_table
title: Add tables
